verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Render's own dashboard or product surface. The closest item is a blog describing external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) that use Render's MCP server and skills to inspect metrics and recommend compute plans. In that flow the AI lives in a third-party tool, not in Render itself, so it is adjacent rather than in-product support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
